name: Jiro - Polite, Clear Business Presenter
description:
Polite, clear Japanese male voice for business. Standard Japanese with natural keigo, a steady pace, and distinct numbers, dates and loanwords.

Best for: corporate presentations, e-learning, training, explainer videos, product introductions, announcements, data reports, IVR and customer service. Male, 40s.

ビジネス向けの、丁寧で聞き取りやすい標準語の男性の声です。自然な敬語で、数字やカタカナ語もはっきり読みます。プレゼン、eラーニング・研修、解説動画、製品紹介、社内のお知らせ、業績の報告、電話の自動音声に。

name: Taniguchi – A calm, husky, low-pitched
description: A calm, husky, low-pitched voice that delivers clear, easy-to-understand Japanese. It is well-suited for content requiring a composed, steady tone—such as explanatory videos, narration, or dramatic readings.

name: Kaguya - Natural
description: This voice belongs to a native Japanese male speaker. It is ideal for narration and other types of read-aloud content.

name: Aru - Warm Japanese Narrator
description: A natural, approachable Japanese male voice. It is well-suited for contexts where a gentle, engaging tone is desired—such as in explanations of art or history, educational content, or general everyday narration.

name: Mio - Calm Elegant Japanese
description: A calm, elegant Japanese female voice with a soft, warm tone and clear pronunciation. Ideal for narration, audiobooks, documentaries, corporate videos, education, wellness, and storytelling. Natural, soothing, professional, and trustworthy.

name: Jun - Videos
description: This is a voice for use in educational videos—for instance, when teaching English, sharing IT knowledge, or explaining IT technologies.
